I5.quote: The development of efficient catalysts for CO₂ hydrogenation is essential for sustainable hydrogen storage and carbon utilization.

notes: ChemRxiv preprint (not peer reviewed) with original experimental data, so not_primary does not apply; record.json is_retracted false and no retraction statement in the PDF; no statement that data were published before. The work is thermal catalytic CO2 hydrogenation to formate over Ru-M dual-atom catalysts on N-doped carbon in 1 M triethylamine solution, not electrochemistry in an electrolyte, so the I1 failure is coded no_conditions_stated (no H2 uptake value). H2 adsorption is discussed only qualitatively in the proposed mechanism (main, pp. 21-23), with no measurement. For reference only (I4 not assessed): BET area 3338 m2/g of the NC support is reported (main, p. 8; Table 1, p. 9).
